classification.difficultyReason: Choose suitable component shapes or enclosing shapes, infer missing lengths from equal-side marks or subtraction, and combine their areas. The hardest parts require recognising a removed triangle or square and selecting the perpendicular triangle height; supplied construction lines support these routine linked procedures.

content.prompt: Calculate the area of these composite shapes.

spec.description: L-shaped figure with a tall right-hand rectangular stem and a lower-left square extension.
spec.mathematics: The stem is 2 m wide and 8 m high. The extension is a 3 m square. Double ticks mark the extension's left side, upper horizontal edge and lower-left base segment only.
spec.answerVisibility: Measurements and equality marks are permanent givens; the supplied area is excluded.

answer.worked:
Split into a rectangle and a square. The matching ticks show that the square has side length $3\,\mathrm{m}$.
$$\begin{align*}A_1 &= 2\times8\\A_1 &= 16\,\mathrm{m}^2\\A_2 &= 3\times3\\A_2 &= 9\,\mathrm{m}^2\\A_{\text{Total}} &= 16+9\\A_{\text{Total}} &= 25\,\mathrm{m}^2\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Trapezium with horizontal parallel bases and a vertical right side; the left side slopes downward to the right.
spec.mathematics: Top base 21 cm, bottom base 17 cm and perpendicular height 9 cm. No right-angle marker is supplied.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the source outline and measurements are visible.

answer.worked:
Split into a rectangle and a triangle.
$$\begin{align*}b_{\triangle} &= 21-17=4\,\mathrm{cm}\\A_1 &= 17\times9\\A_1 &= 153\,\mathrm{cm}^2\\A_2 &= \frac{4\times9}{2}\\A_2 &= 18\,\mathrm{cm}^2\\A_{\text{Total}} &= 153+18\\A_{\text{Total}} &= 171\,\mathrm{cm}^2\end{align*}$$

spec.description: House-shaped pentagon with a rectangular lower section and triangular roof.
spec.mathematics: Base 10 km and wall height 3 km. The external vertical double-headed arrow measures the full height of 6 km, from the base to the apex.
spec.answerVisibility: No roof-height calculation or supplied area appears in the question diagram.

answer.worked:
Split into a rectangle and a triangle. The roof height is the total height minus the wall height.
$$\begin{align*}h_{\triangle} &= 6-3=3\,\mathrm{km}\\A_1 &= 10\times3\\A_1 &= 30\,\mathrm{km}^2\\A_2 &= \frac{10\times3}{2}\\A_2 &= 15\,\mathrm{km}^2\\A_{\text{Total}} &= 30+15\\A_{\text{Total}} &= 45\,\mathrm{km}^2\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Stepped rectangle with its upper-left corner removed.
spec.mathematics: Overall width 6 m and height 5 m. The vertical step is 2 m; matching double ticks show that the adjacent horizontal step is also 2 m.
spec.answerVisibility: The missing corner is not completed or labelled with an answer.

answer.worked:
Subtract the missing square from the large rectangle. The matching ticks show that the square has side length $2\,\mathrm{m}$.
$$\begin{align*}A_1 &= 6\times5\\A_1 &= 30\,\mathrm{m}^2\\A_2 &= 2\times2\\A_2 &= 4\,\mathrm{m}^2\\A_{\text{Total}} &= 30-4\\A_{\text{Total}} &= 26\,\mathrm{m}^2\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Square with a triangular indentation in its right side, retaining the source's slightly raised inward vertex.
spec.mathematics: Top, left and bottom equality marks establish a 14 cm square. The dashed vertical line is the removed triangle's 14 cm base; the dashed horizontal line gives its perpendicular depth of 8 cm. Right-angle marks remain at the two left corners.
spec.answerVisibility: Construction lines and dimensions are source givens. No supplied area or decomposition answer is visible.

answer.worked:
Subtract the triangle from the square. Use the triangle's vertical base of $14\,\mathrm{cm}$ and perpendicular height of $8\,\mathrm{cm}$.
$$\begin{align*}A_1 &= 14\times14\\A_1 &= 196\,\mathrm{cm}^2\\A_2 &= \frac{14\times8}{2}\\A_2 &= 56\,\mathrm{cm}^2\\A_{\text{Total}} &= 196-56\\A_{\text{Total}} &= 140\,\mathrm{cm}^2\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Triangle with a central square indentation extending upward from its base.
spec.mathematics: The external horizontal arrow spans the entire 4 m base, including the indentation. The external vertical arrow gives the full triangle height of 2.5 m. The indentation's top edge is 1 m; matching double ticks establish two 1 m vertical sides.
spec.answerVisibility: No completed triangle base, added decomposition or supplied area appears in the question diagram.

answer.worked:
Subtract the square from the full triangle. The matching ticks show that the square has side length $1\,\mathrm{m}$.
$$\begin{align*}A_1 &= \frac{4\times2.5}{2}\\A_1 &= 5\,\mathrm{m}^2\\A_2 &= 1\times1\\A_2 &= 1\,\mathrm{m}^2\\A_{\text{Total}} &= 5-1\\A_{\text{Total}} &= 4\,\mathrm{m}^2\end{align*}$$
